AUTHOR: González-Vidal
TITLE: AI-driven analysis of fish reproductive behaviour
REGION: Favignana, Egadi Islands MPA, Sicily, Italy (May 2019)
SPECIES: Grey wrasse Symphodus cinereus (male behaviours: 23 action patterns; plus nest, nest core, material, vegetation, female, other fish)
DATA: Own scuba-diver videos of nests, 4 videos (~31 min), 7374 frames at 4 fps; 3638 annotated frames
V_EV: Sec. 2: recorded 'by scuba divers at a depth of 5 m and a distance of about one metre from the nest'; Discussion: 'conducted in clear water and favourable weather conditions'
D2: 70/20/10 train/val/test of annotated frames within each video
D_EV: Sec. 2: 'the annotated frames for each video were split into training (70%), validation (20%), and test (10%) sets'
R_EV: Discussion: 'the size and duration of the dataset limit the generalization ... Future work should therefore incorporate longer video sequences and cross-site validation'
C_EV: no statement found (no confidence threshold or FP verification reported)
E_EV: Sec. 2.4/Table 2: 'We report precision and recall ... and mean Average Precision (mAP) at ... 0.5 (mAP50) and 0.5:0.95'
METR: Precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95 per video, normalized confusion matrices
NOTE: Behaviour sequence (Markov chain) and time-budget analyses appear to be derived from the manual ethogram annotation, not from model output (text calls it 'AI-driven' but methods describe manual coding) -> E1=없음; verify. Frames split within videos (4 fps frames of the same 4 videos) -> D_ALL=N. 'Clear water and favourable weather' is a description of conditions, not stated exclusion (P1 not applied). ENV: site habitat not described (species near seagrass) -> NR. Class count unclear (23 behaviours + 6 object classes, not all annotated).
AUTHORS_FULL: González-Vidal, A; Caruso, S; Badalamenti, F; Argente-Garcia, JE; Willis, TJ; Skarmeta, AF
